tools.name: check_service_area
tools.description: Is a ZIP code in Ryan's service area? He covers Temecula, Murrieta, Menifee, Wildomar, French Valley, Winchester.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: The price for a service, with the plan prices (every 2 or 4 weeks) to offer once. Quotes are the price; Ryan confirms by text.

tools.name: find_open_times
tools.description: Ryan's open start times for this job (they depend on how long it takes). Use a start_time exactly as given.

tools.name: request_booking
tools.description: Book a time for your user (confirm the details with them first). It goes to Ryan as a request: nothing is charged, he texts to confirm, and the customer gets an email with the details and a private link to change or cancel.

tools.name: get_booking
tools.description: A booking, from the private change-or-cancel link in its confirmation email.

tools.name: change_booking_time
tools.description: Move a booking to another open time (find_open_times with the booking's job). Free until 24 hours before; it goes back to Ryan to confirm.

tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.description: Cancel a booking (confirm with your user first). Free until 24 hours before; after that, the customer texts Ryan.

tools.name: apply_mud_run_code
tools.description: Put the customer's own Mud Run code on their Full detail: 10% off the detail (their first Full detail only).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_booking · Private data: request_booking, get_booking · Public sink: request_booking, get_booking · Destructive: apply_mud_run_code.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_booking · Private data: request_booking, get_booking · Public sink: request_booking, get_booking · Destructive: apply_mud_run_code

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
